nvitk.viz.centerline_pick
=========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.viz.centerline_pick

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Centerline polyline picking and plane-frame helpers (shared with flowshow).

.. py:function:: unit_vector(v: numpy.ndarray) -> numpy.ndarray

   Return a unit vector; zero input yields zeros.


.. py:function:: tangent_window_indices(points: numpy.ndarray, idx: int, *, window: int = 5) -> tuple[int, int]

   Inclusive index range ``[a, b]`` used by ``tangent_from_centerline``.


.. py:function:: tangent_from_centerline(points: numpy.ndarray, idx: int, *, window: int = 5) -> numpy.ndarray

   Tangent at ``points[idx]`` from neighbors (window 3 or 5).


.. py:function:: frame_from_tangent(tangent: numpy.ndarray) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]

   In-plane unit vectors ``u``, ``v`` orthogonal to *tangent*.


.. py:class:: CenterlinePick

   Nearest centerline station to a 3D pick point.


   .. py:attribute:: label
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: index
      :type:  int


   .. py:attribute:: point
      :type:  numpy.ndarray


   .. py:attribute:: distance_sq
      :type:  float


.. py:function:: nearest_centerline_on_segments(picked_xyz: numpy.ndarray, centerlines: Mapping[int, numpy.ndarray], *, max_distance_vox: float | None = None) -> CenterlinePick | None

   Snap a click to the closest point on any centerline segment (not only vertices).


.. py:function:: nearest_centerline_along_ray(ray_origin: numpy.ndarray, ray_direction: numpy.ndarray, centerlines: Mapping[int, numpy.ndarray], *, max_distance_vox: float | None = None, anchor_xyz: numpy.ndarray | None = None, max_anchor_distance_vox: float | None = None) -> CenterlinePick | None

   Pick the centerline point closest to the view line through *ray_origin*.

   Uses the full line (both directions along *ray_direction*), so the result does not
   flip when the camera orientation sign changes. Optional *anchor_xyz* rejects snaps
   far from the click in 3D (limits grabbing parallel vessels).


.. py:function:: nearest_centerline_point(picked_xyz: numpy.ndarray, centerlines: Mapping[int, numpy.ndarray], *, max_distance_vox: float | None = None) -> CenterlinePick | None

   Map a 3D pick to the closest point on centerline polylines.


.. py:function:: choose_plane_normal_sense(tangent: numpy.ndarray, plane_center: numpy.ndarray, click_xyz: numpy.ndarray | None = None, *, centerline_pts: numpy.ndarray | None = None, index: int = 0) -> numpy.ndarray

   Resolve ±plane normal using centerline polyline orientation (one sense only).

   The tangent from finite differences is ambiguous; align it with the direction
   along the ordered centerline (index → index+1, or index−1 → index at the end).


.. py:function:: centerline_label_at_voxel(centerline_mask: numpy.ndarray, click_xyz: numpy.ndarray) -> int | None

   Skeleton mask label under the click (0 = background).


.. py:function:: centerline_label_near_click(centerline_mask: numpy.ndarray, click_xyz: numpy.ndarray, *, radius_vox: float = 2.0) -> int | None

   Most common skeleton label in a small neighborhood around the click.


.. py:function:: pick_centerline(picked_xyz: numpy.ndarray, centerlines: Mapping[int, numpy.ndarray], *, max_distance_vox: float, max_ray_distance_vox: float | None = None, max_anchor_distance_vox: float | None = None, centerline_mask: numpy.ndarray | None = None, ray_origin: numpy.ndarray | None = None, ray_direction: numpy.ndarray | None = None, use_view_line: bool = False) -> CenterlinePick | None

   Snap the click to the nearest point on a centerline polyline (segment-wise).

   In 3D with *use_view_line*, snap to the view line through the click (perpendicular
   distance), then fall back to 3D distance if no segment is close enough to that line.

   When several vessels are close, each label is scored separately; the skeleton label
   near the cursor breaks ties only when picks are similarly close.


.. py:function:: refine_pick_to_vertex_if_closer(pick: CenterlinePick, centerlines: Mapping[int, numpy.ndarray], click_xyz: numpy.ndarray, *, max_distance_vox: float = 2.5) -> CenterlinePick

   Prefer the nearest polyline vertex when the click is closer to it than the segment snap.


.. py:function:: smooth_polyline_display(points: numpy.ndarray, *, n_out: int | None = None) -> numpy.ndarray

   Optional spline resampling for smoother Tracks display (picking uses raw *points*).
